تألمنت (form IIq)
# تَأَلْمَنْتُ (taʔalmantu) /ta.ʔal.man.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَأَلْمَنَ (taʔalmana)
# تَأَلْمَنْتَ (taʔalmanta) /ta.ʔal.man.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَأَلْمَنَ (taʔalmana)
# تَأَلْمَنْتِ (taʔalmanti) /ta.ʔal.man.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَأَلْمَنَ (taʔalmana)
# تَأَلْمَنَتْ (taʔalmanat) /ta.ʔal.ma.nat/: t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
